source.title: Executive Office of the President section (Table-5 cap-fit unit, page 19). Full 9-column outlays model. Corpus unit #20 and formal non-arithmetic audit target. Self-contained: no cell overlaps another unit's table. Family pattern: plans/treasury-mts-2026-05-outlays-table5.md.
source.period: May FY2026 (This Month = May 2026; Current FYTD = Oct 2025 - May 2026; Prior FYTD = Oct 2024 - May 2025)

unit_note: USD millions ('[$ millions]' per table header). Table 5 legend (p. 23): '......' = 'No Transactions' (omitted); '(**)' = 'Less than absolute value of $500,000' -- omitted (Other Prior-FYTD Applicable; Proprietary This-Month Applicable/Outlays; Intrabudgetary This-Month Gross/Outlays; Total This-Month Applicable). Values as printed, thousands separators stripped, negatives as leading '-'. Full visual render and cid-decoded text-layer cross-check completed for page 19. Current-FYTD section roll-up and total-row identity each require tol 1 under the printed rounding note. The two line-level Proprietary Applicable cells are standalone single-source values; their section-total counterparts are covered by total-row identities. This is corpus unit #20 and must receive a different-agent spot-audit in AUDITS.md.

cells.why: Applicable Receipts on 'Proprietary Receipts from the Public', a line with no Gross Outlays (Gross column '......'): Outlays(net) = -Applicable, but the offset has no Gross cell to target and Proprietary is the only printed Applicable source in this period (single-source column, no >=2-source roll-up). Relation-free within this unit; the section-total Applicable cell is covered by the total-row net identity.

Applicable Receipts on 'Proprietary Receipts from the Public', a line with no Gross Outlays (Gross column '......'): Outlays(net) = -Applicable, but the offset has no Gross cell to target and Proprietary is the only printed Applicable source in this period (single-source column, no >=2-source roll-up). Relation-free within this unit; the section-total Applicable cell is covered by the total-row net identity.
